meta.write: signed-strain blob as an a priori
meta.tesla: exacting, not a jerk. One-sided is a number. Large versus D is a different number. A leftover that no longer cancels is not a bound.

lemmas.name: B28_blob_readable
lemmas.statement: signed-strain blob, one-sided net, and visc-owned cubic are readable together
lemmas.why: Cancel sits near 0.83. P/D sits near 0.008. Ẋ < 0. Typed c is not written into the PDE.

lemmas.name: B28a_onesided_not_a_priori
lemmas.statement: a one-sided (ω·Sω)_+ leftover closes a bound for classical X
lemmas.why: Coherence killed cancellation. It did not make P large versus D. A leftover is not continuation.

lemmas.name: B28b_sign_not_a_class
lemmas.statement: sitting a blob where S_zz keeps a sign is a geometric class that bounds X
lemmas.why: Localization in z is a knob. A z-independent tube in the same strain still cancels (B17c). Do not promote a sign to a type.

lemmas.name: B28c_peaked_not_integral_max
lemmas.statement: an L² bound on this peaked blob is an integral bound on the max vorticity
lemmas.why: ‖ω‖_∞/‖ω‖₂ climbed from 0.2 to ~2.4. The criterion still asks for ∫‖ω‖_∞. Do not improve a peaked packet into the max.

lemmas.name: B28d_nu_not_continuation
lemmas.statement: turning ν down until Ẋ>0 is a continuation argument for classical X
lemmas.why: That is a knob on the check. B17f already missed the retune. The working box stayed ν=0.1. Do not spawn a thinner visc.

lemmas.name: B28e_occupation_leftover
lemmas.statement: field occupation of CONC closes X
lemmas.why: Scored as B18e / B29. A clock that stays CONC is not continuation. Field-glue leftover is B19e. Do not spawn n=64.

lemmas.name: B28f_not_a_pde_retune
lemmas.statement: scoring the signed-strain blob as not an a priori is a retune of classical Navier–Stokes
lemmas.why: The PDE is untouched. One-sided is a knob on the estimate: a leftover you can miss. No Q1. No ε.

next_da_move: Packet geometry is not an a priori (B14d). Stretching budget is not an a priori (B15e). Enstrophy balance is not an a priori (B16e). Coherent blob is not an a priori (B17e). Field occupation is not an a priori (B18e). Field-glue leftover is B19e. Finer (n>32) stays a box knob (B22e). Do not spawn n=64. B4c stands. Do not cancel to Φ.
